changelog.change: Replaced largest-connected-component significance statistic with 2D spatial scan statistic (max count over (2R+1)x(2R+1) windows via summed-area table) evaluated with exact empirical p = (1 + sum(null >= obs)) / (K + 1) <= 0.01 at every annual sample in the persistence window against both uniform and resource-weighted nulls
changelog.motivation: Motivated by simulation results: yes (Phase 3 300-agent run, v1 passed a uniformly spread population because the largest connected component spanned the entire map)

changelog.change: Added min_enrichment_ratio (2.000000) effect-size floor comparing observed max window count against the larger of the two null means (uniform and resource-weighted)
changelog.motivation: Motivated by simulation results: yes (prevents large populations with tiny density fluctuations from triggering statistical significance without true demographic aggregation)

changelog.change: Maintained v1 member-Jaccard rule (min_jaccard_similarity 0.500000) and centroid drift (max_centroid_drift_cells 2) as required gating persistence criteria; added footprint Jaccard as informational metric. Consecutive annual overlap measures year-to-year continuity and does not preclude a settlement outliving its founders
changelog.motivation: Maintains strict continuity requirements for social and demographic cohort retention across consecutive annual samples

changelog.change: Configured null spatial extent to use binding declared world extent when available, falling back to occupied bounding box
changelog.motivation: Ensures spatial null permutations sample over the true physical landscape when known, preventing outlier wanderers from artificially diluting the null domain

changelog.change: Pre-registered calibration targets (FPR <= 3% across 200 uniform worlds, statistical power >= 95% at 3x enrichment for N=100 and N=300) and negative/positive control worlds list
changelog.motivation: Pre-registers formal falsification benchmarks and control regimes prior to implementation

changelog.change: Documented scan window radius R as cell units (scan_window_radius_cells: 2) with cell size declared in binding; added elongated 2x12-cell cluster control to report outcome without threshold tuning
changelog.motivation: Clarifies dimensional units and benchmark performance on asymmetric/ribbon settlements

changelog.change: Group emergence parameters: no change from v1
changelog.motivation: Maintains strict parity; group emergence remains unchanged

changelog.change: Cultural spread emergence parameters: no change from v1
changelog.motivation: Maintains strict parity; cultural spread remains unchanged

description: Pre-registered quantitative operational definitions of emergence for GENESIS Alpha (v2: scan statistic settlement fix with member persistence retention).
